title: Provider use-after-free: module unloads between lookup and dispatch
description: ioctl_init: (1) thread A calls crypto2dev_lookup_algo() at line 604, gets ops+owner, try_module_get succeeds. (2) Before ops->sess_init() executes at line 627, provider module completes rmmod (no active sessions yet — module refcount is 1 from try_module_get, but kmod will wait... actually try_module_get prevents unload). Re-examine: once try_module_get succeeds, rmmod blocks. NOT a UAF. HOWEVER: crypto2dev_lookup_algo() walks the provider list under rw_lock; once lock is released, a concurrent unregister_provider could remove the entry and kfree the ops struct if the module has already done module_put internally. Verify whether the ops struct lifetime is tied to the module or to the registered provider entry. If ops is on the module's stack or freed in module_exit before unregister_provider completes, use-after-free is possible.
close_reason: False positive: try_module_get succeeds under read_lock (registry.c:190) before lock release; ops and provider structs are static module data — no heap free, no UAF possible
